learningOutcomes: Create and modify a perpendicular structural framing column using an explicit cross-section, anchor point and plane-based height.
Assign representation, material, trade, calculation mode and classification data required for downstream schedules and exchange checks.
Verify the column workflow without treating software output as structural design approval.
prerequisites: Allplan 2026 workspace with the Structural Framing task available in the installed license.
A project building structure and plane model whose story elevations have already been checked.
p3-c1-m1.interfaceContext: Architecture role > Structural Framing task > Structural Framing Objects > Structural Framing Column

stepsEvidence.title: Open Structural Framing Column and define geometry
stepsEvidence.expectedOutput: The Geometry tab shows the agreed cross-section, dimensions and anchor point.

stepsEvidence.title: Bind top and bottom levels to the checked plane model
stepsEvidence.expectedOutput: The Height dialog shows explicit top and bottom plane references and the preview is placed in the correct story.

stepsEvidence.title: Assign attributes and verify downstream classification
stepsEvidence.expectedOutput: Material, trade, calculation mode and classification are visible and the agreed exchange check identifies the object as IfcColumn.

p3-c1-m1.learnerOutput: One modelled structural framing column with reproducible geometry, plane-based height, attribute data and an IfcColumn verification result.

checkpoint.prompt: Submit the three workstation screenshots and the agreed IfcColumn verification result for the created object.
checkpoint.acceptanceCriteria: Geometry, plane references, attributes and exchange classification must match the reviewed evidence pack.

assessmentQuestion.prompt: Which settings must be verified before a structural framing column can be trusted in schedules and IFC exchange?
assessmentQuestion.expectedAnswer: Cross-section and anchor point, top and bottom plane references, material and trade, calculation mode, attributes and the resulting IfcColumn classification.
